# Ayushi Diyora

> Frontend Developer specializing in React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript with 2+ years of experience building fast, scalable web applications and intuitive user interfaces.

## About
Ayushi Diyora is a Frontend Developer based in Surat, Gujarat, India. She specializes in building production-grade web applications, interactive dashboards, and responsive digital products using modern web technologies including Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Core Skills
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, HTML5, CSS3
- **State & Data**: TanStack Query (React Query), Redux Toolkit, Context API, REST APIs
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose
- **Tooling & Practices**: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Responsive UI, Core Web Vitals Optimization, SEO / AEO

## Key Projects
- [ScrapeSmart AI](https://scrape-smart-ai.vercel.app/): AI-powered web scraper that extracts content from any website URL and answers questions conversationally. Case study available at https://ayushi-dev.vercel.app/projects/scrapesmart-ai.
- [Lumina Metrics](https://lumina-metrics-ad.vercel.app/): Modern SaaS analytics dashboard with interactive data visualizations, KPI tracking, and responsive management interfaces.
- [Growchief](https://prod-grow-chief-nine.vercel.app/): Agricultural platform interface featuring fluid animations, clean design system, and responsive UX.
- [TG Immigration](https://tgimmigration.com): Clean, client-centric digital platform for an immigration consultancy.
